'''2010 Malastare Regionals''' was a Players Committee regional, 31 July 2010, using the [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]] pool. The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDF ([[:File:2010 Malastare Regionals.pdf]]).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 31 July 2010
* '''Winner:''' —
